description: Get a network brief for a Trackly job ID, including company signal, recommended motion, top contact and suggested actions. Missing or closed postings return availability=unavailable with retryable=false; search for another opening. Failures include a category and retry guidance.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

jobId.description: Positive numeric Trackly job ID from trackly_search_jobs or your saved queue, not an employer requisition ID or URL. Correct invalid arguments before retrying.

name: trackly_get_job_brief
